docs(plans): Spacetime Canvas implementation plan (T-047 expansion)

Expands T-047 Foundation into a build plan, anchored on a live inspection of
the reference scroll UI (v0 timeline-explorer) performed 2026-08-01.

Key architectural finding: that UI is Next + GSAP + Lenis with ZERO canvases.
Its DOM is two layers — a `.fixed.inset-0` background holding a cross-fading
&lt;img&gt; stack, and a sibling `.absolute.inset-0` narrative layer running CSS 3D
(perspective 900px, preserve-3d, translateZ). The background is a slot, and
the narrative layer never touches WebGL.

So the Spacetime Canvas globe drops into that slot and the scroll narrative
becomes Guided Investigations rendered as descent — unifying storyboard
Concepts 01 and 02 into one surface rather than two, which is the same
two-navigation-systems failure ADR 0002 rejected for GL4SS.

Records three risks to measure while building (fixed-WebGL-under-preserve-3d
jank; whether the temporal cursor is driven or driving; 19 hardcoded cases vs
a real query layer), makes the reconstruction lever non-negotiable — scrolling
past a waypoint is not an intent signal — and sequences M0-M4 with M0 exit
criteria.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 &lt;noreply@anthropic.com&gt;
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Qn8vb6wahKHq7nocyPTSLa
EOF

docs(plans): Spacetime Canvas implementation plan (T-047 expansion)

Expands T-047 Foundation into a build plan, anchored on a live inspection of
the reference scroll UI (v0 timeline-explorer) performed 2026-08-01.

Key architectural finding: that UI is Next + GSAP + Lenis with ZERO canvases.
Its DOM is two layers — a `.fixed.inset-0` background holding a cross-fading
&lt;img&gt; stack, and a sibling `.absolute.inset-0` narrative layer running CSS 3D
(perspective 900px, preserve-3d, translateZ). The background is a slot, and
the narrative layer never touches WebGL.

So the Spacetime Canvas globe drops into that slot and the scroll narrative
becomes Guided Investigations rendered as descent — unifying storyboard
Concepts 01 and 02 into one surface rather than two, which is the same
two-navigation-systems failure ADR 0002 rejected for GL4SS.

Also lands the FEATURES.md Focus Area #8 note (Neon Files SDK / file-based
storage) that was staged as concurrent WIP — strategic/tracking only; blocked
on Neon region GA.

Records three risks to measure while building, makes the reconstruction lever
non-negotiable, and sequences M0–M4 with M0 exit criteria.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 &lt;noreply@anthropic.com&gt;
EOF

import { type NextRequest } from 'next/server'
import { getSightingsByTimeChunk, getSightingsStats } from '@/services/sightings/get-sightings'

export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  try {
    // Get query parameters
    const url = new URL(request.url)
    const startYear = parseInt(url.searchParams.get('startYear') || '1940')
    const endYear = parseInt(url.searchParams.get('endYear') || new Date().getFullYear().toString())
    const limit = parseInt(url.searchParams.get('limit') || '100')
    const includeStats = url.searchParams.get('stats') === 'true'

    // Validate API key
    const apiKey = request.headers.get('x-api-key')
    if (!process.env.INTERNAL_API_KEY || apiKey !== process.env.INTERNAL_API_KEY) {
      return Response.json(
        { error: 'Unauthorized' },
        { status: 401 }
      )
    }

```bash
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}s\n" http://localhost:3000/spacetime && cd apps/app && bun -e '
import { filterSpacetimeEvents, DEFAULT_EVIDENCE_FILTERS } from "./src/features/spacetime/lib/filter-events.ts";
import { loadSpacetimeEvents } from "./src/features/spacetime/actions/load-spacetime-events.ts";
const r = await loadSpacetimeEvents({ startYear: 1940, endYear: 2026, limit: 400 });
const layers = { sightings: true, historicalEvents: true, nuclear: true, military: false, infrastructure: false, testimony: false, documents: false, reconstructions: false };
const all = filterSpacetimeEvents(r.events, layers, DEFAULT_EVIDENCE_FILTERS).length;
const hi = filterSpacetimeEvents(r.events, layers, { ...DEFAULT_EVIDENCE_FILTERS, credibilityMin: 0.8 }).length;
const noSight = filterSpacetimeEvents(r.events, { ...layers, sightings: false }, DEFAULT_EVIDENCE_FILTERS).length;
const noInferred = filterSpacetimeEvents(r.events, layers, { ...DEFAULT_EVIDENCE_FILTERS, epistemic: { documented: true, inferred: false, disputed: true } }).length;
console.log({ total: r.events.length, all, hiCred: hi, noSightings: noSight, noInferred });
' 2>&1 | tail -20
```
